![A project dashboard page in Genos with headline numbers, a milestone bar and who holds the open work](/lp/guide/en/dashboard.webp)

Pick a project, a milestone or your own progress. Choose when it runs.

```flow
Schedule it once
Each run replaces the page
Open it from your Inbox
```

The names it lists link back into Genos. A plain dashboard uses no AI; an AI summary is optional and uses AI credits. Core and above.
